Scope: PR 1 = the draft layer and Discard / Save: changes on a list apply at once and are not stored; Save on a personal view stores to it; "Save as my view" asks for a name first (default "VIEW copy"); a toast after saving; the chips stay after saving back. Desktop shows Discard plus Save ▾; narrow widths show one Save that opens three items, in the shared `conditionRowEnd` slot the phone list (#35883) also draws. PR 1 stops reading and writing the draft parts of the server list preference. PR 2 (new session) = "Save to this view" on a shared view, with its confirm and publish, on the same path as #35932. PR 3 (new session) = retiring the server `ui.list` preference for what is left. Seat accepts the thread's readings R1–R5 in the plan (search is draft-lived but lights no buttons and is not saved; a reload clears drafts while a copied link still filters; layout, row colour and inline-edit toggles are drafts; no new kanban stage control; Discard looks like #35892's). Two questions go to the maintainer before PR 2 and PR 3: where column widths live (D1) and whether "Save to this view" on a shared view publishes at once (D2).
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #35678 and #35883 run in parallel threads on overlapping files; `overlap-check.mjs` runs after the first commit and before each push. The branch is the card thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Ruling record · 2026-11-21T06:27Z · The maintainer (os-sales) answered the seat's decision card (D2 of the card thread's plan) at 2026-11-21T06:26Z, choosing 「确认后立即对所有人生效」:
- "Save to this view" on a shared view: after the one confirm step ("everyone using this view will see it"), the change is saved and published at once; other users see it on refresh, as this card's acceptance says.
- If the view already has an unpublished draft (for example a footer calculation pick from #35702's flow), Save does not publish that draft on someone's behalf: it says so and points to the view settings to publish or discard it first; the buttons stay.
- This explicit, confirmed Save is the exception to ruling 7045525672 (#35702), whose "toolbar controls never write a shared view directly; changes go to a draft first" still holds for every implicit change.
- Settled earlier by the maintainer and not asked again: column widths, row height and tab order live only in this browser (card body, rewritten after the maintainer's 「只记在浏览器里」).

Applies to PR 2 of this card (claim 7058427316), which is ordered after #35932.

File surface: app-shell `ObjectView.tsx` (shared "Save to this view": confirm, draft read, write and publish), `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`, `listDraftStore.ts`, the phone 「保存 ▾」 and the options-menu Save; plugin-list `ListView` (an optional `onRowColorChange`; layout already goes out through `onViewChange`), `viewDefaults` two optional entries; about five i18n keys in every locale; tests, changeset.
Container & model: `M`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`

Basis: card #35955; maintainer ruling D2 A (7058616478): confirm once, then publish at once; an existing unpublished draft is not published on anyone's behalf.
Scope, the seat's reading: "Save to this view" shows for the same people who can save a footer calculation (admin, a stored view, the package does not refuse saves). Confirm once → read the view's unpublished draft → if one exists, refuse and point to view settings → else write the draft and publish at once → toast 「已保存，所有人可见」; if publish fails, the draft just written is discarded. The server does not record a draft's author, so any existing draft refuses, including one the same person saved earlier: that is the only way to honour "not on someone else's behalf". Layout and row colour go into the draft and both Save paths keep them (F1). F5: the shared save leaves the view's row height alone and never publishes the reader's; the personal save keeps the reader's row height as today. G2: one test pins each of the two reload edges as they are.

Area: b1-L

Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-j9w929
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: app-shell `context/ListPreferencesProvider.tsx`, `UserStateAdapters.tsx`, `console/ConsoleShell.tsx`, `views/ObjectView.tsx`, `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`, `objectViewListUrlState.ts`, `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`, `listDraftStore.ts`, `personalViews.ts` (types), `listFilterStorage.ts` (removed, F4); a new `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/list-preferences.ts` with an integration test and a no-auto-run test; docs (`views.mdx`, `upgrading.mdx`, `deployment/cli.mdx`, READMEs, the `sys-user.page.ts` comment, the platform checklist rows on list widths); tests; changesets (console upgrade note, `@objectstack/cli` minor).
Container & model: `M/L`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`. Over 3,000 lines → the CLI command splits into its own PR.
Clause-②: no for the client (private app-shell, no i18n keys, no published package change); the CLI command is not exported from `packages/cli/src/index.ts` (oclif discovery), so no; re-measured on built declarations before push.
Metadata-protocol: none (no spec, REST or published schema change; the spec `columnState` key retires later through a handover card)
Premise (thread, read on main `7dd1a2f6`, file `build-seat1/35955/pr3/premise.md` in the project folder): holds. After PR1 only column widths, row height and tab order still write `ui.list.<object>`; no server code reads `ui.list.*`.
Basis: card #35955 (title: widths, row height and tab order only in the browser; stored rows are cleared by an upgrade script); maintainer: 「清掉」; ruling D1 (browser-only).
Scope, the seat's reading: option B of the premise. `ListPreferencesProvider` becomes browser-only under a new local key; the old `list-state:*`, `list-filters:*` and `viewOrder:*` keys are cleared once, nothing migrated; the list no longer waits for the preference read; `ConsoleShell` and `UserStateAdapters` drop the `ui.list.` family. Stored server rows: `os migrate list-preferences`, following the `os migrate` / `os db orphans` precedent: report by default; `--apply` exports the rows to an owner-only file and reads it back, deletes every `sys_user_preference` row whose key starts `ui.list.` as the system identity, then reads back zero; re-runnable; never on a boot or upgrade path. `ui.record.*` is untouched.
Open, to the maintainer after fable review; the thread builds as today until then: (P3-1) sign-out and session expiry clear localStorage, so browser-only widths are lost at every sign-out; keeping a `list-layout:` prefix for the same person would widen the sign-out purge. (P3-2) the related-list tab's column widths are stored per person on the server, the opposite of ruling D1; not in this PR either way.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: parallel with PR2 (session `session_01L6bhgWyeXh2Keywo6oK1Nn`); whichever lands second merges main. Does not touch `RelatedList.tsx` (#35892). `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. L1 at L1-b. The PR carries `Part of #35955` (the last of PR2/PR3 to merge carries `Fixes #35955`; the seat says which).

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer rulings · 2026-11-21T14:38Z · #35955 PR3, two answers on the seat's decision cards (both reviewed by fable first)

1. **Sign-out keeps the list layout for the same person** (option A, 2026-11-21T14:35Z). After PR3, column widths, row height and tab order live only in the browser. Signing out or a session ending keeps them for the same person; a different person signing in on that browser still clears everything, as today. Why it was asked: the sign-out purge (#29174, generalised by #32048) was justified by "server preferences are untouched, re-login gets them back", and D1 removes that server copy; filters, sorts and search terms are in-memory drafts since PR1, so what stays is object names, field names, widths and view ids, no record data. Built as its own small card after PR3 merges (it is an exception to a rule the security seat landed): the sign-out tier of `@object-ui/auth` keeps the layout keys, the change-of-user tier does not; a test pins what may live under those keys; the P1 checklist item `identity-auth.console-sign-out-and-ended-session` and the auth README change with it. PR3 ships with today's purge, which loses nothing that a later keep would need.
2. **The record page's related-tab column widths are browser-only too, built in #35892** (option A, 2026-11-21T14:35Z). Recorded on #35892.

本机深度验收 · 2026-11-21T22:47Z · objectstack `6c7c6db250`，1440 宽，自建应用「客户」列表（共享视图）和 HotCRM「全部客户」。每项都看了有没有写请求。

通过：
- 列头菜单升序/降序、筛选、分组、视图设置里点眼睛隐藏列、视图设置里调列顺序（键盘）：都进草稿，出现「放弃」「保存」，没有写请求。
- 「放弃」还原；刷新后草稿丢掉、地址里的 `uf__sort` 清掉；带草稿排序点开第 3 条，记录页显示「第 3 条，共 12 条」，后退后草稿还在。
- 「另存为我的视图」：默认名「客户 副本」，确定后切到新视图、列顺序带过去、提示「已保存」。
- 列宽、行高：不出现按钮；各有一次 `PATCH sys_user_preference`（PR 3 之前的预期）。

不通过，一项：
- **列头菜单里的「隐藏列」不出现「放弃」「保存」**。列消失、没有写请求、刷新后恢复，所以它确实是临时的，但用户既没法保存也没法放弃，只能刷新。同一个操作从「视图设置」里点眼睛就是好的。验收项「隐藏一列……出现『放弃』『保存』」在这条路径上不成立。

另有一项已单独立卡：底部统计点了就写视图（objectstack-ai/objectstack#36194、objectstack-ai/objectstack#36195）。

观察（不算不通过）：
- 加分组时默认取第一列「客户名称」，12 条记录分成 12 组，默认值没有意义。
- 行高三档叫「紧凑 / 标准 / 宽松」，默认的 36 是「紧凑」。

没有测的：鼠标拖列头换顺序（自动操作拖不动）、看板上的草稿、另一个用户不受影响（本机没有第二个登录会话）、「保存到这个视图」（PR 2 未合并）。
